module_summary: APB clock-domain crossing bridge: a slave-side request is synchronized through two-flop request/ack handshake registers into the master clock, replayed as an APB master transaction, and read data returned with PREADY.

anchors.name: S_APB_PSEL
anchors.why: Slave APB select; with !PENABLE starts a new cross-domain request.

anchors.name: S_APB_PENABLE
anchors.why: Slave APB access phase; setup detection uses its absence.

anchors.name: S_APB_PREADY
anchors.why: Slave ready pulse when synchronized ack returns; clears request regs.

anchors.name: S_APB_PADDR
anchors.why: Slave address forwarded to M_APB_PADDR.

anchors.name: S_APB_PWRITE
anchors.why: Read/write direction forwarded to master side.

anchors.name: S_APB_PWDATA
anchors.why: Slave write data forwarded to M_APB_PWDATA.

anchors.name: S_APB_PRDATA
anchors.why: Read data returned to slave from m_prdata.

anchors.name: S_APB_PSLVERR
anchors.why: Slave error response from m_pslverr gated by PREADY.

anchors.name: M_APB_PSEL
anchors.why: Master APB select asserted from synchronized m_request until ack.

anchors.name: M_APB_PENABLE
anchors.why: Master APB access phase following PSEL.

anchors.name: M_APB_PREADY
anchors.why: Master completion; sets m_ack and captures read data.

anchors.name: M_APB_PADDR
anchors.why: Master address, pass-through or registered copy of slave address.

anchors.name: M_APB_PWDATA
anchors.why: Master write data copied from slave side.

anchors.name: M_APB_PRDATA
anchors.why: Master read data captured into m_prdata.

anchors.name: s_request
anchors.why: Registered pending slave request, held until PREADY.

anchors.name: s_tfr_request
anchors.why: Request crossing to master clock; gated by full_reset and s_ack.

anchors.name: m_request
anchors.why: Request synchronized into master domain, launches M_APB_PSEL.

anchors.name: m_ack
anchors.why: Master-domain ack set on transfer completion, cleared when request drops.

anchors.name: s_ack
anchors.why: Ack synchronized back to slave clock, produces S_APB_PREADY.

anchors.name: m_prdata
anchors.why: Holds master read data across the clock crossing.

anchors.name: m_pslverr
anchors.why: Holds master error response for slave side.

anchors.name: full_reset
anchors.why: Slave-domain sync of master reset release; enables request transfer.

groups.name: Slave-side request
groups.description: Registers slave request, forwards across domain, issues PREADY on synchronized ack.

groups.name: Master-side transaction
groups.description: Synchronizes request, drives APB master PSEL/PENABLE, generates ack.

groups.name: Response data crossing
groups.description: Captures master read data/error and presents them to slave port.

groups.name: Request payload forwarding
groups.description: Address, write data, strobes and prot passed to master port.

groups.name: Reset synchronizers
groups.description: Cross-domain reset synchronization gating request transfer.

groups.name: Slave APB handshake
groups.description: APB select/enable inputs and master ready input.
